hero.subtitle: Stop meditating randomly. Train your nervous system with structure — and watch it respond in real time. Your body is a biocomputer. ONDA is the OS.

concept.titlePrefix: Your Body is the Most Complex
concept.subtitle: Most meditation is random: a session here, an app there, nothing connecting them. ONDA is a structured path. You start by steadying your nervous system, then build from there — and you can watch your HRV respond while you practice. Each level rests on the one before it.

cards.title: Systematic
cards.description: Not random meditations. A structured protocol grounded in how the nervous system actually works.

cards.title: Progressive
cards.description: Each level builds on the last — from steadying your baseline to focus, emotional regulation, and beyond.

cards.title: Measurable
cards.description: Track real signals — HRV, sleep, stress — and watch your trend move over weeks, not just one morning number.

levels.subtitle: Unlike fragmented meditation apps, ONDA is a structured progression through 8 levels. Each one builds on the last — from steadying your body to the quietest states of long practice.

items.name: BODY / TERRA
items.description: Breathing, diaphragm, and HRV — the foundation of parasympathetic activation.

items.name: EMOTIONS / AQUA
items.description: Working with stress and emotional reactivity — steadier responses when things get heavy.

items.name: MIND / AER
items.description: Attention and focus — training a calmer, clearer mind.

items.name: SOCIETY / IGNIS
items.description: Connection and social calm — showing up steadier around other people.

items.name: BODY II / TERRA II
items.description: Deeper embodiment — moving from thinking about the body to feeling it. Flow and ease in motion.

items.name: BRAIN / AQUA II
items.description: Self-awareness and metacognition — watching your own mind with more clarity.

items.name: DNA / AER II
items.description: Where the practice stops being something you do and becomes part of who you are. Months of consistency settling into a steadier baseline.

items.name: ATOMIC / IGNIS II
items.description: The deep, quiet states long-term practitioners describe — total presence, the self going still. Experiential, not measured. The edge of the map.

items.title: Tracker Integration
items.description: Connect Apple Watch, Oura, Garmin, or a chest strap. Watch your HRV, sleep, and stress move in real time.

items.title: Gamified Progression
items.description: Earn OND for completed practices and streaks. Unlock themes and extra protocols as you go.

items.title: Structured System
items.description: No random meditations. Each practice targets a specific system: breathing, emotions, mind, recovery.
